from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRdExpense(BaseModel):
    """A company's reported R&D expense for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    rd_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The R&D expense amount as a numeric value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the R&D expense figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_rd_expenses: list[CompanyRdExpense]
